description: A query string with doseq appended to a URL that already has '?'; a json body's own Content-Type/Content-Length; a raw string body's default application/x-www-form-urlencoded Content-Type; a duplicate Set-Cookie response header (first position, last value); a non-UTF-8 response body (U+FFFD replacement); a HEAD request (headers but no body, on either side of the wire); parse: json raising on a non-JSON body versus parse: auto falling back to text.
